title: Bee-sy as a Bee

Place it near your hive to confuse wasps or use it as a conversation starter at your next 'I'm not a hipster, I just like bees' party.

title: The Lifted Life
tagline: For the urban forager who's tired of tripping over their own stuff. This cable-lifted rack turns your clutter into a floating art installation. tagline: For when you want to propose in a way that guarantees they'll remember the exact moment they found a diamond in their bathwater. Perfect for the 'I forgot the ring but still want to make it romantic' crowd. Just don't drop it down the drain.

title: Bathe in Beefy Bliss?

title: Mystery Balls of Doom

Perfect for the person who’s convinced their chakras need a tune-up but refuses to buy actual crystals. Bonus: They make a satisfying *clank* when you inevitably drop them during your midnight yoga session.

title: Brie Your Own Adventure
tagline: For the lactose-tolerant survivalist who thinks 'apocalypse prep' means stockpiling gouda. Includes everything but the cow’s existential crisis.

title: Headphones for Your Headphones
tagline: Because your over-ear cans need their own personal space too. Perfect for the audiophile who wants to listen to their high-end headphones while also drowning out the world. Ideal for those moments when you're trying to enjoy your music, but your cat insists on sitting on your head.

title: Bug-Off Bracelet
